newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Merck invests NLG 700 mln in Dutch fund.
newsitem.headline: Merck invests NLG 700 mln in Dutch fund.

text.p: ABN AMRO Bank said on Wednesday that Merck Sharp & Dohme Overseas Finance SA had invested another 700 million guilders in Dutch money market fund ABN AMRO Liquiditeiten Groeifonds.
The unit of U.S. pharmaceuticals maker Merck & Co invested 560 million guilders in the same fund in 1996 but a spokesman for ABN AMRO said Merck had later sold most of these shares.
The present investment was made as part of Merck's cash management operations. An arrangement was made through which Merck can sell its shares in the fund or buy additional ones.
In addition to the ordinary shares in ABN AMRO Liquiditeiten Groeifonds, Merck Sharp & Dohme Overseas Finance SA will also buy 10 priority shares in the money market fund from ABN AMRO.
"ABN AMRO is convinced that this investment will be beneficial for both the investment fund and its shareholders," the bank said.

It added that Merck's investment had raised the size of the the Netherlands' largest money market fund to about four billion guilders. The fund will not invest in debt issued by Merck, ABN AMRO added.
